description:
Create a new Godot scene (.tscn) with a tree of nodes in one call, including their properties, textures, collision shapes, scripts and groups. Use this to create player scenes, UI screens, game objects, etc.

**All-or-nothing:** the whole tree is built and checked in memory first. Unknown node types or property names (with suggestions), values of the wrong type, missing resource files and bad scripts are ALL reported together as path-pointed `validation_errors` (e.g. `nodes[1].children[0].properties.texture: no resource at res://hero.png`), and no file is written unless everything is valid.

attach_script.description: Optional script path to attach to root node (res://path/to/script.gd)

nodes.description: Child nodes to create under the root. Each node spec: {name|node_name, type|node_type, properties?, script?, groups?, children?}. Unknown keys (e.g. "class", "parent") are errors. properties values: Values are read according to each property type: numbers/bools/strings; enums by name ("Nearest") or number; Vector2/3 as {x, y[, z]} or [x, y[, z]]; Color as {r, g, b, a?} (0..1), "#ff8800" or "red"; resources (texture, shape, mesh, material, stream, ...) as a file path "res://icon.png" or an inline resource {type: "CircleShape2D", radius: 12} whose other keys are its properties. Same forms as set_node_properties.

items.description: A node spec: {name|node_name, type|node_type, properties?, script?, groups?, children?}. Unknown keys are rejected with an error.

root_node_name.description: Name of the root node. Default: the file name in PascalCase (res://player_ship.tscn -> PlayerShip).

root_node_type.description: Type of root node (e.g., Node2D, CharacterBody2D, Control, Node3D). REQUIRED.

name: create_scene
